body.title: Propagate the profile through coordinator and Git scopes
body.summary: Update scripts/test-harness/context.mjs and existing child environment composition in scripts/test-harness/process.mjs as required by actual call paths. Use fixed coordinator defaults and canonical profile in every owned child/custom/private-npm environment; supply omission, reject conflict and Windows case aliases. Preserve exact validated explicit overrides and lease/run schemas. Select Git role in src/installer/dev-git.ts. Use existing coordinator fixtures, with proposed focused policy tests as needed.
acceptanceChecks: Existing normal DEFAULT_BUDGETS and Git values remain exact; slow role values reach run.json and actual retained child environments.
Deliberately short explicit clocks remain exact after selection; invalid overrides still reject.
Omitted selectors are restored from admitted snapshot and conflicting/invalid selectors reject before spawn, including duplicate Windows key casing; private npm aliases retain the profile.
Existing lease ownership, unique admission/close/disposal journals and strict closure behavior are preserved.
